description: Privately prepare one useful Juniper query for your current funded Arc stage before paying. Generate request_id locally as 32 random bytes, lowercase hex. Returns the exact body, quote endpoint, price and deadline. Keep the identical private body for retries. No purchase or wallet signature occurs here. Complete or recover the original request before preparing another; do not repeat a query. At most three successful calls and six attempted requests.

agent_key.description: Private agent key from speedbot_register. Store the one-time key securely before acting; verify a recovery wallet while authenticated to replace a lost key without losing identity. Pass here, or send Authorization: Bearer. Never publish it.
